name: Big Tech
description: The companies that run the digital world, from IBM and Microsoft to Apple, Google, Amazon, Meta and Nvidia, with their founders and the products people buy and use.

checkpoints.name: The first giants
checkpoints.note: IBM rules computing with its mainframes. Intel is founded and makes the first microprocessor, and Samsung starts making electronics.

checkpoints.name: The PC years
checkpoints.note: Microsoft and Apple are founded. The Apple II, MS-DOS, the Macintosh and Windows bring the computer to homes and offices, and Nvidia is founded.

checkpoints.name: The dot-com age
checkpoints.note: Amazon, Google and Facebook are founded. Windows rules the desktop, the iMac and iPod save Apple, and Google becomes the way the world searches.

checkpoints.name: Phones and the cloud
checkpoints.note: The iPhone and Android put a computer in every pocket. Amazon's cloud powers the web, and Apple becomes the first company worth a trillion dollars.

checkpoints.name: The AI race
checkpoints.note: Microsoft backs OpenAI, Google and Meta race to build AI, and Nvidia's chips make it one of the most valuable companies in the world.
